Name: Bregs Goats
Author: Bregodon
Description:
[color=#ffd966][size=3][b]Bregs Goats is a goat retexture with added horns and color variations.[/b][/size][/color]

The goal is to enhance the goats visual appearance to intensify the game experience.
The goats basic shape remains nearly unchanged to preserve the beloved Stardew Valley feeling.

[color=#93c47d][b][size=3]Compatible with SDV 1.3 beta[/size]
[/b][/color]
----------

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=3]Features[/size][/color]

[/b][list]
[*][size=3][size=2]Choose between nine eye-candy color variations.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=2]Added small gray horns for adults.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=2]Goats have a wobbling tail. Yes, it's cute![/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=2]A lot of pixel art (pixel shifts & color corrections for head, ears and body).[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=2]Finally goats have a smaller udder than cows.[/size][/size]
[/list][size=2]
----------

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=3]Options[/size]
[/color][/b]
﻿[i]configurable via config.json, automatically created after first startup[/i]

[color=#ffd966] ﻿[/color][size=3][color=#ffd966]Color (black/brown/chocolate/creme/gray/orange/red/white/yellow)[/color]
[/size] ﻿ ﻿Changes the color of the goats.

[color=#ffd966] ﻿[size=3]Horns (true/false)[/size][/color]
﻿ ﻿Enable or disable the small gray horns for adults.[color=#cccccc][size=2]
[/size][/color]
----------

[color=#6d9eeb][size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#ffd966][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url][/color].
[*][color=#ffd966][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url][/color].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
----------
